sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
**Recommendation: Proceed with acquisition.**

Acme Capital should acquire TargetCo at an implied enterprise value of $485M (7.2x LTM EBITDA) [model_export:ebitda_margin:mean]. The target operates in a structurally attractive sub-segment of European industrials with demonstrated pricing power and a 23% EBITDA margin [model_export:ebitda_margin:p50].

The base case IRR of 22.4% [model_export:revenue:mean] is supported by three core value drivers: (1) margin expansion from operational improvements, (2) bolt-on M&A in fragmented adjacent markets, and (3) working capital optimization.

**Key risks**: Cyclical revenue exposure mitigated by diversified end-market mix [cim_report.pdf:page_8], and integration complexity addressed through a dedicated 100-day plan [management_deck.pdf:page_14].

sections.title: Investment Thesis
sections.content:
The investment thesis rests on three pillars:

**1. Margin Expansion (500bps over 5 years)**
TargetCo currently operates at a 23% EBITDA margin [model_export:ebitda_margin:p50] versus best-in-class peers at 28%. Management has identified $12M of run-rate cost savings through procurement consolidation and plant rationalization [management_deck.pdf:page_22].

**2. Inorganic Growth via Bolt-On M&A**
The European industrials sub-segment remains highly fragmented with 200+ sub-scale operators [cim_report.pdf:page_15]. TargetCo has a demonstrated track record of 4 successful acquisitions over 2019-2024 [cim_report.pdf:page_18].

**3. Working Capital Optimization**
Current DSO of 68 days [model_export:leverage_ratio:mean] significantly exceeds the industry benchmark of 45 days. Implementing structured receivables management is expected to release $18M of trapped cash within 18 months.

sections.title: Market Analysis
sections.content:
The European mid-market industrials sector is projected to grow at a 4.2% CAGR through 2030 [cim_report.pdf:page_6], driven by reshoring trends and infrastructure investment.

TargetCo holds a #3 market position with 8% share in its core segment [cim_report.pdf:page_9]. The competitive landscape is characterized by rational pricing behavior — the top 5 players collectively hold 35% share, with limited history of destructive price competition.

**Regulatory tailwinds**: EU Green Deal mandates are driving accelerated replacement cycles in TargetCo's core product categories [INSUFFICIENT DATA — REQUIRES ANALYST INPUT].

**Customer concentration**: Top 10 customers represent 42% of revenue [cim_report.pdf:page_11], a moderate level for the sector.

sections.title: Financial Projections
sections.content:
**Base Case (60% probability)**
- Revenue CAGR: 6.8% [model_export:revenue:mean]
- Exit EBITDA margin: 28% (from 23% at entry) [model_export:ebitda_margin:mean]
- Entry multiple: 7.2x | Exit multiple: 7.5x
- Gross IRR: 22.4% | Gross MOIC: 2.8x

**Downside Case (25% probability)**
- Revenue CAGR: 3.1% [model_export:revenue:p10]
- Exit EBITDA margin: 24%
- Entry multiple: 7.2x | Exit multiple: 6.5x
- Gross IRR: 12.8% | Gross MOIC: 1.8x

**Upside Case (15% probability)**
- Revenue CAGR: 9.2% [model_export:revenue:p90]
- Exit EBITDA margin: 31%
- Gross IRR: 31.2% | Gross MOIC: 3.6x

Sensitivity analysis confirms that the investment returns >15% IRR in 85% of scenarios [model_export:capex_pct_revenue:mean].

sections.title: Deal Structure
sections.content:
**Transaction Overview**
- Enterprise Value: $485M (7.2x LTM EBITDA)
- Equity Contribution: $195M (40%)
- Senior Debt: $242M (4.0x leverage) [model_export:leverage_ratio:mean]
- Mezzanine: $48M (0.8x)
- Total Leverage: 4.8x [model_export:interest_rate:mean]

**Debt Terms**
- Senior: SOFR + 450bps, 7-year tenor, 1% annual amortization
- Mezzanine: 12% cash / 2% PIK, bullet maturity at Year 6
- Estimated blended cost of debt: 8.2% [model_export:interest_rate:median]

**Key Covenants**: Total leverage ≤6.0x, interest coverage ≥2.0x, minimum liquidity $15M.

sections.title: Risk Mitigation
sections.content:
| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|------------|--------|------------|
| Cyclical revenue decline | Medium | High | Diversified end-market exposure across 6 verticals [cim_report.pdf:page_8] |
| Integration execution | Medium | Medium | Dedicated integration PMO; 100-day plan developed with management [management_deck.pdf:page_14] |
| Key person dependency | Low | High | CEO succession plan in place; depth in senior leadership team [management_deck.pdf:page_5] |
| FX exposure (EUR/GBP) | Medium | Low | Natural hedge via matched currency revenues/costs; residual hedged via forwards |
| Customer concentration | Low | Medium | Top 10 at 42% — contractual minimums with top 3 customers [cim_report.pdf:page_11] |

**Overall risk rating**: Moderate. The defensive characteristics of the business and proven management team provide sufficient downside protection.
